spans.s:
m. (-थः)
Swelling, intumescence.
E.
शु to go, (to grow,) Uṇādi aff. थन्; also with कन् added शोथक m. (-कः)

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Discutient, removing swellings.
f. (-घ्नी)
Hogweed, (Boerhavia diffusa.)
E.
शोथ swelling, घ्न removing, fem. aff. ङीष्.

mfn. (-जित्)
Discutient.
f. (जित्)
Hogweed: see the last.
E.
शोथ swelling, and जित् overcoming.

mfn. (-हृत्)
Discutient, removing swellings.
m. (-हृत्)
Marking-nut plant.
E.
शोथ swelling, and हृत् removing.
